note: atomgrid mechanics: coordinate-compress the STEP-0 2x2 segment bag (one full v@1440, one full h@900) over a 2880x1800 canvas. xs gathers {canvas x-faces 0,2880} + {v.coord 1440} + {h endpoints 0,2880}; ys gathers {0,1800} + {h.coord 900} + {v endpoints 0,1800}. Result: xs=[0,1440,2880], ys=[0,900,1800] (the 2x3-1=4-atom lattice). Pins the compress step independently of the DSU.
